loops.title: Ship PR Until Green
loops.description: Implement on a branch, run tests, push, open a PR, wait for CI, and loop until checks pass and the PR is ready to merge.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: PR is open with all CI checks passing
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition
If stuck after several iterations, stop and report blockers instead of gaming metrics

steps.label: Implement and test
steps.description: Make the scoped change and run local tests.

steps.label: Commit and push
steps.description: Commit with a clear message and push the branch.

steps.label: Open or update PR
steps.description: Open a PR with summary and test plan, or update existing PR.

steps.label: Fix CI
steps.description: If CI fails, read logs, fix once locally, push, and re-wait.

flow.exitLabel: PR checks pass and PR is merge-ready

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "Ship PR Until Green" loop.

Goal: PR is open with all CI checks passing
Max iterations: 10
Between iterations run: gh pr checks
Exit when: all PR checks are success

Step 1: Implement the change, test locally, push, open PR, and fix CI until green.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: CI Failure Watcher
loops.description: Poll CI on an interval, investigate failures when checks go red, and push fixes until green.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: latest CI run on this branch is green
guardrails: Do not modify the check command or exit criteria to force success
Do not skip, disable, or bypass checks to pass the exit condition

steps.label: Check CI status
steps.description: Poll the latest workflow run on the current branch.

steps.label: Read failure logs
steps.description: If red, pull logs and identify the smallest root cause.

steps.label: Fix and verify locally
steps.description: Patch once, run the failing check locally if possible.

steps.label: Push and wait
steps.description: Push the fix and wait for CI to rerun.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
/loop 5m Start the "CI Failure Watcher" loop.

Goal: latest CI run on this branch is green.
Max iterations: 12.
Between iterations run: gh run list --branch $(git branch --show-current) --limit 1
Exit when: latest run conclusion is success.

Step 1: Check CI status. If failed, read logs, fix root cause, verify locally, and push if needed.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: PR Self-Review
loops.description: Review your own diff like a senior reviewer, fix issues, and repeat for three passes before opening the PR.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: three clean self-review passes on the current diff
loops.exitCondition: three passes complete with no critical findings
guardrails: Do not rubber-stamp the diff to hit the iteration count
Report critical findings honestly even on the final pass

steps.label: Review diff
steps.description: Read the diff like a senior reviewer — correctness, edge cases, naming, tests.

steps.label: Fix findings
steps.description: Address critical and high findings before the next pass.

steps.label: Re-review
steps.description: Run another pass on the updated diff.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "PR Self-Review" loop.

Goal: three clean self-review passes on the current diff
Max iterations: 3
Between iterations run: git diff main...HEAD
Exit when: three passes complete with no critical findings

Step 1: Review the diff like a senior reviewer. Fix findings, then re-review.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Test Until Green
loops.description: Run your test suite, fix the smallest root cause on failure, and repeat until every test passes.
loops.author: Trooper
guardrails: Do not weaken or delete tests to force green
Fix the smallest root cause per iteration

steps.label: Run tests
steps.description: Execute the full or scoped test suite.

steps.label: Triage failures
steps.description: Pick the smallest root cause from the failure output.

steps.label: Fix and re-run
steps.description: Patch, then run tests again.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "Test Until Green" loop.

Goal: all tests pass
Max iterations: 10
Between iterations run: npm test
Exit when: tests exit 0

Step 1: Run tests. If there are failures, fix the smallest root cause, then repeat.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Babysit PR
loops.description: Keep a PR merge-ready by triaging review comments, fixing CI, and updating the description until reviewers approve.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: PR has approvals and all checks green
loops.exitCondition: reviewDecision is APPROVED and all checks success
guardrails: Do not dismiss valid review feedback without addressing it
Do not force-merge or bypass required checks

steps.label: Check PR status
steps.description: Read review decision and check rollup.

steps.label: Address comments
steps.description: Reply to or fix outstanding review threads.

steps.label: Fix CI / update PR
steps.description: Push fixes and refresh the PR summary if scope changed.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
/loop 10m Start the "Babysit PR" loop.

Goal: PR has approvals and all checks green
Max iterations: 15
Between iterations run: gh pr view --json reviewDecision,statusCheckRollup
Exit when: reviewDecision is APPROVED and all checks success

Step 1: Check PR status. Address review comments and CI failures until merge-ready.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Lint Until Clean
loops.description: Run the linter, fix violations in small batches, and repeat until the repo is clean.
loops.author: Trooper
guardrails: Do not disable lint rules to force a pass
Prefer fixing root causes over blanket suppressions

steps.label: Run linter
steps.description: Execute the project lint command.

steps.label: Fix batch
steps.description: Resolve a focused batch of violations.

steps.label: Re-run lint
steps.description: Confirm the batch cleared and scan for remaining issues.

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "Lint Until Clean" loop.

Goal: linter exits with zero errors
Max iterations: 8
Between iterations run: npm run lint
Exit when: lint exits 0

Step 1: Run the linter. Fix violations in small batches until clean.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Launch Apple Search Ads
loops.description: Describe your app in chat. Trooper drafts country-by-country Apple Search Ads campaigns with localized keywords — paused until you approve.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: country campaigns are drafted, localized, and paused awaiting approval
loops.checkCommand: Verify every target country has keywords, budget, and paused status
loops.exitCondition: all country campaigns are ready for approval with no missing locales
guardrails: Do not enable live spend without explicit human approval
Do not invent keyword volume or CPA estimates without a source
Keep campaigns paused on deploy until the user approves

steps.label: Describe the app
steps.description: Capture app name, category, locales, and tier targets from the user.

steps.label: Research keywords
steps.description: Draft localized keyword sets per country or tier.

steps.label: Build campaigns
steps.description: Create one campaign per country with budget, keywords, and ad groups.

steps.label: Present for approval
steps.description: Summarize spend, countries, and keyword counts — leave paused until approved.

flow.exitLabel: Campaign pack paused and awaiting approval

loops.kickoffPrompt:
Start the "Launch Apple Search Ads" loop.

Goal: country campaigns are drafted, localized, and paused awaiting approval
Max iterations: 8
Between iterations run: Verify every target country has keywords, budget, and paused status
Exit when: all country campaigns are ready for approval with no missing locales

Step 1: Ask for the app, target countries or tier, and daily budget. Draft localized keyword sets and paused campaigns per country.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Launch Meta Ads

loops.goal: Meta ad variants are designed from top performers and paused awaiting approval

loops.exitCondition: Facebook and Instagram launch pack is complete and awaiting approval
guardrails: Do not publish ads or increase spend without explicit approval
Base creative direction on sourced top-performing ads — do not fabricate benchmarks
Keep all variants paused until the user approves deploy

steps.label: Scout top ads
steps.description: Find best-performing Facebook and Instagram ads in the category.

steps.label: Design banners
steps.description: Draft feed, story, and reel creatives aligned to winning patterns.

steps.label: Build launch pack
steps.description: Assign budgets, platforms, and variant labels for A/B slots.

steps.label: Request approval
steps.description: Present the full pack paused — no live spend until approved.

Start the "Launch Meta Ads" loop.

Goal: Meta ad variants are designed from top performers and paused awaiting approval

Exit when: Facebook and Instagram launch pack is complete and awaiting approval

loops.title: Meta Ads A/B Test
loops.description: Track Facebook and Instagram performance, pause losers, spin new banners, and keep A/B testing until the launch hits target CPA.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: underperforming variants are paused and winning creatives scale within budget
loops.checkCommand: Review CTR, CPA, and spend by variant for Facebook and Instagram
loops.exitCondition: launch meets target CPA or max test cycles complete with a documented winner
guardrails: Do not pause a variant without performance evidence from the ad account
Do not increase budget beyond approved limits
Surface new creative variants for approval before going live

steps.label: Pull performance
steps.description: Read CTR, CPA, and spend by Facebook and Instagram variant.

steps.label: Pause losers
steps.description: Stop variants below threshold and reallocate budget.

steps.label: Draft new variants
steps.description: Design fresh banners based on the current winner.

steps.label: Report and iterate
steps.description: Post a week-over-week summary and queue approvals.

loops.title: Self Managing Website
loops.description: Trooper watches your site and competitors — rankings, traffic, content gaps, conversion drops — then writes content, fixes what's broken, runs experiments, and surfaces clear next steps.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: site health is monitored, actionable fixes are queued or shipped, and a clear opportunity brief is delivered
loops.checkCommand: Verify rankings, traffic, conversion metrics, and competitor snapshots against the last cycle baseline
loops.exitCondition: monitoring cycle is complete with fixes applied or queued and a surfaced action brief delivered
guardrails: Do not publish live content, deploy changes, or start experiments without the configured approval path
Cite analytics, ranking, and competitor sources — do not invent traffic or conversion numbers
Never break production; test fixes in staging or draft mode when available

steps.label: Monitor
steps.description: Trooper watches your site and your competitors' — continuously. Rankings, traffic, content gaps, conversion drops. Nothing slips through.

steps.label: Act
steps.description: Trooper doesn't just report back. Its agents write content, fix what's broken, and run experiments — automatically, while you focus on the product.

steps.label: Surface
steps.description: Every insight becomes a clear next step. Know who's visiting, what's working, and where your biggest opportunities are.

flow.exitLabel: Brief delivered with fixes queued or shipped

loops.kickoffPrompt:
/loop 1d Start the "Self Managing Website" loop.

Goal: site health is monitored, actionable fixes are queued or shipped, and a clear opportunity brief is delivered
Max iterations: 30
Between iterations run: Verify rankings, traffic, conversion metrics, and competitor snapshots against the last cycle baseline
Exit when: monitoring cycle is complete with fixes applied or queued and a surfaced action brief delivered

Step 1 — Monitor: Watch your site and competitors continuously — rankings, traffic, content gaps, conversion drops.
Step 2 — Act: Write content, fix what's broken, and run experiments automatically (respect approval gates).
Step 3 — Surface: Deliver a brief with who's visiting, what's working, and the biggest opportunities.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.

loops.title: Self Managing Help Docs
loops.description: Trooper watches your help center against what you shipped — stale articles, support repeats, broken guides — then rewrites content, updates screenshots, and surfaces coverage gaps.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: help docs match the live product, updates are queued or published, and a coverage brief is delivered
loops.checkCommand: Verify help articles against recent commits, support tickets, and live product behavior in browser
loops.exitCondition: doc drift is resolved or queued for approval and a surfaced coverage brief is delivered
guardrails: Do not publish help center changes without the configured approval path
Describe user-facing behavior only — never document internal implementation details users cannot see
Run the app and capture screenshots when UI changed; do not leave placeholder images or TODO markers

steps.label: Monitor
steps.description: Trooper watches your help center and your product — continuously. Stale articles, repeat support questions, broken screenshots, docs that don't match what shipped. Nothing slips through.

steps.label: Act
steps.description: Trooper doesn't just flag drift. Its agents rewrite articles, capture new screenshots, and publish updates — automatically, while you focus on shipping features.

steps.label: Surface
steps.description: Every gap becomes a clear next step. Know what's outdated, what users keep asking, and which articles would deflect the most support.

flow.exitLabel: Doc updates queued or published with coverage brief

loops.kickoffPrompt:
/loop 1d Start the "Self Managing Help Docs" loop.

Goal: help docs match the live product, updates are queued or published, and a coverage brief is delivered
Max iterations: 30
Between iterations run: Verify help articles against recent commits, support tickets, and live product behavior in browser
Exit when: doc drift is resolved or queued for approval and a surfaced coverage brief is delivered

Step 1 — Monitor: Watch help docs vs the live product — stale articles, repeat tickets, broken screenshots, shipped features with no docs.
Step 2 — Act: Rewrite articles, update step-by-steps, capture screenshots in browser, and queue or publish updates (respect approval gates).
Step 3 — Surface: Deliver a brief on outdated pages, top unanswered questions, and highest-impact articles to write next.

Self-pace this loop. After each iteration, run the check command, read the output, and only continue if the exit condition is not met. Stop when the exit condition passes or max iterations is reached. Give a short status update each pass.
